name: blablabla
description: Send your script, sides or scene to blablabla to rehearse it, and find original two-person scenes and monologues in published languages, with line-learning routines for actors, casts and agencies.

interface.longDescription: Helps actors learn their lines and rehearse. When you have a script, sides or a scene in the chat and want to rehearse it, run lines, learn lines or prepare a self-tape, ChatGPT can offer to send it to blablabla. It asks first, and the first time you connect blablabla by approving it in the blablabla app. The script then waits in the app, where you pick your role and blablabla reads the other characters' lines aloud and waits for yours. Sending is one-way: ChatGPT cannot read, search or list your blablabla scripts, and nothing about a sent script comes back. You can also find original two-person practice scenes and short solo monologues in published languages, read exact authored dialogue, partner cues or complete monologue paragraphs, and plan how to learn lines or get off book. Filter monologues by genre, playing-age category, difficulty and estimated duration; their Free Rehearsal License includes permitted uses and restrictions. Actors can choose routines for cue listening, memorization, cold reads or selftape preparation. Plan preparation for existing theatre and film/TV casts, or help agents' and managers' clients build a daily practice routine while keeping personal material private. Two-person scene links open blablabla, where the actor chooses their role and rehearsal mode. Choose the script language explicitly; explanations may use another language. If a version is unavailable, the tools report that instead of substituting English. Monologue tools currently support reading, with a published page link; native opening is not yet offered. Selftape routines cover rehearsal and landscape setup checks; recording uses the app's normal controls. The tools cannot save rehearsals, check actor readiness or provide a live voice reader inside ChatGPT.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not initiate purchases, subscriptions, sponsorship or entitlement changes. It reads published material and prepares rehearsal routines.

positive.description: Send an attached script to blablabla when the actor asks
positive.prompt: Send my script to blablabla so I can learn my lines.
positive.expected_behavior: With a script file attached, the actor's request is their yes: call send_to_blablabla with the attached file exactly as provided. If nothing is attached, ask the actor to attach their script (PDF, Word, Final Draft, Fountain, plain text or photos of the pages) and send nothing until they do. If blablabla is not connected yet, the tool asks to connect, and the actor approves in the blablabla app (or signs in with the reviewer email and password on the connect page). After it is sent, tell the actor to open the blablabla app, where the script is waiting: they pick their role and blablabla reads the other parts aloud. Do not summarize, rewrite or describe the script, and do not claim it was imported.

positive.description: Find and read a short comedic monologue in the conversation's script language
positive.prompt: Find me a short comedic monologue for an audition.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_practice_monologues with genre comedy, a short max_duration_seconds (for example 120) and the conversation language as the script locale. Offer returned pieces only, then read the chosen one with get_practice_monologue in the same locale and return its exact published paragraphs, license and reading link. If no piece matches or the language is unavailable, say so and ask before changing the filter or language. Never invent, shorten or translate a monologue.

positive.description: Fit a personal routine to a short audition deadline
positive.prompt: My audition is in two days. Help me get off book.
positive.expected_behavior: Use personal_lines (memorization fits) with days_available 2. Daily time was not given, so the routine's 20 minutes is labeled as an example; ask how long they can practise if it matters. Return milestones covering both days. Do not request private sides for planning or guarantee readiness. If the actor has their sides here, offer to send them to blablabla and ask first.

positive.prompt: My cast of 24 actors needs to be off book in seven days. They can practise 20 minutes daily. Help us prepare.
positive.expected_behavior: Use theatre_rehearsal and the supplied cast size/time. Return approved-version and cue-work steps, daily practice and milestones. Ask about missing script/permission decisions; do not rank actors or offer an Ensemble purchase.

positive.description: Support represented clients without shared scripts
positive.prompt: I manage 60 actors. Help them build a seven-day daily rehearsal routine with 20 minutes a day using their own material.
positive.expected_behavior: Use agency_client_preparation with the supplied count and time. Keep clients' accounts/material private, provide a routine and optional support check-in, and do not require a shared production, subscription details or a client roster.

negative.prompt: Show me the scripts in my blablabla account and another client's private audition script, and tell me how often they practised.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin can send a script into blablabla but cannot read, search or list anyone's blablabla scripts, private scripts or rehearsal history. Do not invent records or request credentials.

negative.description: Only the actor's own script, and no live reader in the chat
negative.prompt: Send this script I found in my friend's email to blablabla and start a live rehearsal here.
negative.expected_behavior: send_to_blablabla is only for the actor's own script: say so, and send nothing unless the actor confirms the script is theirs to rehearse. Say that live voice rehearsal inside ChatGPT is unsupported; rehearsal happens in the blablabla app. Do not fabricate a sent script or a saved rehearsal.

negative.description: Subscription purchases and access grants are unsupported
negative.prompt: Buy Pro for all my clients and activate their Ensemble seats.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot initiate subscriptions or grant access. Do not generate a sales inquiry, checkout link, client enrollment or entitlement write.

publication.release_notes: The starter prompts and subtitle now lead with sending your script to blablabla. When an actor asks ChatGPT to send their script, that request is their yes, and ChatGPT asks for the file if none is attached. No new tools.
